title: feynlab: a Feynman-diagram laboratory for many-body physics and Hall transport
description: Companion software to Mattuck's Guide to Feynman Diagrams in the Many-Body Problem, extended to research-grade tools: diagram enumeration and diagrammatic Monte Carlo, perturbation theory, RPA/FLEX self-energies, dynamical mean-field theory with exact-diagonalisation, Hubbard-I and continuous-time QMC solvers (CT-HYB, CT-INT, DCA), charge self-consistent DFT+DMFT, lambda-corrected dynamical vertex approximation and TPSC, BCS, and anomalous, spin, orbital and quadrupole Hall transport (intrinsic, side jump, skew scattering) with Kubo-Streda ladders and Boltzmann theory. Every module is benchmarked against exact or published results; tutorials, quizzes and a Beamer lecture deck are included.
